Changed: Regex from `\[(.+)\]` to `\[(.+?)\]` to use non-greedy matching.

Ran: `python3 -m pytest -q test_src.py`

Result: `2 passed in 0.02s`

The greedy `.+` was matching from the first `[` to the last `]`, capturing text between tags. Non-greedy `.+?` matches each tag independently, so `"[a] and [b]"` now correctly returns `["a", "b"]`.
